# FAQ-025 Engineering FAQ #25

Revision: Rev A

Q1: What lubricant part number is specified for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01)?
A1: The lubricant part number for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is CFW-LUB-724. See ECN-2026-043 for approval history.

Q2: What lubricant part number is specified for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01)?
A2: The lubricant part number for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01) is CFW-LUB-723. Refer to SOP-P2-L4-03 for handling and storage requirements.

Q3: What is the spindle warm-up time for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03)?
A3: The spindle warm-up time for Machining CNC turning center #3 (EQ-P1-L3-CN03) is 27 minutes. Confirm procedure steps in MM-P3-L3-CN02 prior to warm-up.

Q4: What is the way lube refill interval for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02)?
A4: The way lube refill interval for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02) is 70 hours. Log refills per MM-P3-L3-CN02 and reference ECN-2026-043 for any changes.

Q5: What lubricant part number is specified for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01)?
A5: The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is CFW-LUB-961. Check SOP-P2-L4-03 for approved dispensing methods.

Related documents: ECN-2026-043, MM-P3-L3-CN02, SOP-P2-L4-03.
